title: Auditing Cross-Dataset Claims in Wearable EMG Representation Learning: A Public-Data Case Study
target: Anonymized peer-review source package with compiled PDFs, source-data summaries, vector figures, checksums, and manifests.
archive_boundary: This review source package contains manuscript-ready tables/figures and does not redistribute raw third-party EMG data, model checkpoints, embedding caches, raw-window feature parquet files, prediction caches, local launcher logs, machine-local paths, public repository identifiers, or public archive identifiers.
excluded_from_package: local launcher logs and helper-only machine artifacts
LaTeX build logs and auxiliary files

compiled_outputs.status: Compiled PDFs regenerated from the anonymized review sources with R/ggplot2/ggprism vector figures; page counts, logs, font embedding, and checksum coverage verified before packaging.

claim_boundaries.overall_framing: Reproducible claim-control and audit framework for cross-dataset EMG representation learning; not a deployable controller, domain-invariant physiology claim, reduced-recalibration claim, prosthetic-control transfer claim, or clinical-readiness claim.
claim_boundaries.alignment: Small unwhitened alignment signal only; whitened CKA decreased and auxiliary endpoints were mixed.
claim_boundaries.domain_recoverability: Post-freeze fixed probes test package/source identity recoverability, not physiological domain identity or calibrated domain invariance.
claim_boundaries.ontology_gate: Hyser-GRABMyo supervised transfer is not evaluable under the frozen-package ontology gate because provider-backed one-to-one control-intent semantics are absent from the frozen package.
claim_boundaries.downstream: Downstream screens did not establish pretrained-feature superiority over raw or classical signal-feature baselines.

verification_files.verify_internal_checksums: sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt on POSIX systems, or an equivalent SHA256 verifier on Windows.
